name: NVIDIA Dynamo recipes speed four Korean models on B200
title: NVIDIA Dynamo recipes speed four Korean models on B200
summary: NVIDIA published Dynamo deployment recipes for SK Telecom A.X K2, LG AI Research K-EXAONE 2.0, Upstage Solar Open 2, and Motif-3. The recipes deliver up to 2x inference performance on NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
